newsitem.title: USA: U.S. June S&P 500 futures rise opening 7-pt limit.
newsitem.headline: U.S. June S&P 500 futures rise opening 7-pt limit.

text.p: U.S. June Standard and Poor's 500 futures rose the opening seven-point trading limit.
If June were locked down limit at 0840 CDT/1340 GMT, there would be a two-minute trading halt, after which trading would resume with the initial 15-point down limit in effect.
There is no initial upside trading limit.

June S&P 500 futures rallied overnight on followthrough from Thursday's gains and continued their strength early Friday amid Treasury bond strength. Traders said comments Thursday from Federal Reserve Chairman Alan Greenspan buoyed bonds.
